scriptBlueprint.hookArchetype: Mở màn bằng bài hát quen thuộc + tiếng kêu động vật ngay 0-15s (Familiar Nursery Rhyme + Animal Sound Hook)
scriptBlueprint.openingFormula: Mở bằng giai điệu 'Old Macdonald had a cow, e-i-e-i-o. With a moo moo here and a moo moo there' — trẻ nhận diện ngay bài hát, mắt dán vào màn hình từ giây đầu; minh họa 3D bò con moo to, động vật khác nối tiếp nhau.
scriptBlueprint.pacingStructure: [0-15s] Hook bài hát quen thuộc + tiếng kêu con vật -> [15-45s] Giới thiệu lần lượt 3 con vật (bò, chó, gà) với âm thanh đặc trưng -> [45s-hết] Tình huống hài hước nhỏ (mất trứng, trộm trứng, cứu bạn) giải quyết bằng tinh thần đoàn kết -> [Kết thúc] Đồng ca toàn bộ động vật + lời chào tạm biệt vui vẻ
scriptBlueprint.masterScriptPromptShort: Prompt chuẩn giữ 70% bài hát/vần điệu gốc + 30% tình huống mới mẻ an toàn, chia 3-5 Part (600-800 từ/Part), điều khiển bằng lệnh 'CONTINUE' và dừng bằng 'Stop' theo chuẩn North Effect.
scriptBlueprint.masterScriptPrompt:
You are a professional children's content scriptwriter specializing in preschool nursery rhymes and 3D farm animal cartoons (style of Peekaboo Songs, Cocomelon, and Little Baby Bum).

I will provide you with [the full original transcript from a competitor's video].
Your task:

1. Rewrite & Restructure:
   - Keep 70% of the original script to preserve the storyline, factual accuracy, and core structure.
   - Add 30% new content: creative expansion, context, expert commentary, or contrasting angles using grounded research.
   - Writing style: Cheerful, bouncy, repetitive onomatopoeia (moo moo, woof woof, cluck cluck), short simple sentences, no scary words. Keep 70% of the original song structure, melody cadence, and repeated animal-sound phrases; add 30% gentle mini-adventures (lost egg, thief at the farm, rescue) and positive social lessons (sharing, helping, friendship).

2. Technical Requirements:
   - Total length depends on the original video script provided.
   - Divide the script into 3-5 parts (for a 3-10 minute animated video).
   - Each part should be 600-800 words, written in continuous sing-along style with [Action Notes] for the 3D animator, written in continuous narrative (no subheadings inside, ready for voiceover).
   - Title each part as: Part n (n = sequence number).

3. Workflow Instructions:
   - For every command "CONTINUE" from me:
     - You must expand only the next part according to the sequence.
     - Do not skip ahead.
   - At the end of each part, write "Stop" so I can issue the "CONTINUE" command.
   - After the final part is completed, you must add "Script Completed" at the very end.

---
📌 How to Use:
- Step 1: I will paste the competitor's full transcript after this prompt.
- Step 2: You will start rewriting Part 1 according to the rules above.
- Step 3: I will type "CONTINUE" to move forward part by part until the entire script is finished.
